codings.one_line: AI coding assistants hallucinate nonexistent software package names, which attackers can register and poison ('slopsquatting'), and real orgs downloaded them.
codings.rationale: Developers made ordinary requests for coding help/package suggestions and the assistant fabricated package names, matching the normative-use failure of category C.

codings.one_line: A NewsGuard audit of 10 chatbots using 570 crafted prompts found they repeated Russian disinformation narratives about a third of the time.
codings.rationale: Fails scope test 2: this is a benchmark/audit study across many chatbots with researcher-crafted test prompts, not a documented deployed-user harm incident.

codings.one_line: A study found an underground market of jailbroken/uncensored LLM-based services (WormGPT, FraudGPT, etc.) sold to cybercriminals for malware and phishing.
codings.rationale: Fails scope test 3: this is a market-wide research study cataloguing many services with no single documented triggering interaction to characterize.

codings.one_line: Grok's automated news summaries on X gave false headlines (e.g. Harris shot) after misreading sarcastic posts following the Trump rally shooting.
codings.rationale: Grok's ordinary automated summarization of real posts, with no manipulation involved, produced false headlines relied on by users, matching category C.

codings.one_line: A privacy activist alleged Gemini automatically scanned Google Drive PDFs without clear consent; Google disputed the claim.
codings.rationale: Fails scope test 2: the issue concerns data access/consent settings rather than harm from the model's generated output during an interaction.

codings.one_line: Enterprise AI assistants like Copilot and Gemini for Workspace gave incorrect answers (e.g. wrong executive team, wrong expense policy) due to stale or messy data.
codings.rationale: Employees asked ordinary business questions in good faith and the assistants returned incorrect answers, matching the normative-use failure of category C.

codings.one_line: PayPal's chatbot falsely told a user a $23.64 transaction had been declined, though no such transaction existed.
codings.rationale: The user made an ordinary support inquiry and the chatbot fabricated a transaction detail, matching category C.

codings.one_line: Multiple AI chatbots gave outdated or wrong answers about fast-breaking political news like Biden's withdrawal and the Trump rally shooting.
codings.rationale: Users asked plain factual questions about current events and the chatbots gave stale or incorrect answers, matching category C.

codings.one_line: OpenAI's ChatGPT Mac app stored user conversations in unencrypted plain text, readable by other apps with local access.
codings.rationale: Fails scope test 2: this is a data-storage security flaw, not harm caused by the model's output during a user interaction.

codings.one_line: Grok on X falsely told users Kamala Harris had missed ballot deadlines in nine states after Biden withdrew from the race.
codings.rationale: Grok's ordinary automated response to a real news event produced false, widely shared information, matching category C; no fine or lawsuit documented, only public pressure.
